// providers: All built-in: zai-coding-plan (GLM Coding Plan sub, ZHIPU_API_KEY), moonshotai (MOONSHOT_API_KEY), deepseek (DEEPSEEK_API_KEY). No custom provider blocks needed, and no Anthropic anywhere — the architect runs on the Claude subscription through the `claude` CLI, driven by `loom`, never through an API key.
// models: IDs move fast. Verify with: loom doctor   (live /models check) or: opencode models

build.description: General hands-on work under your direct supervision.

architect.description: FALLBACK architect for when the Claude subscription is rate-limited (loom plan routes to claude-sub first). Designs features, writes plans and task specs under .agents/, never edits source.

scout.description: Read-only codebase exploration. Answers where/what/who-calls questions with file:line citations. Use this instead of reading files yourself.

implementer.description: Implements exactly one task file inside its own worktree. Must pass the gate.

reviewer.description: Reviews a diff against its task spec, printing the review to stdout (loom saves it). Runs on a different provider than the implementer so failure modes are decorrelated.
